english_draft:
Historical reconstruction: This preview of SK hynix's 2026Q1 results is a retrospective reconstruction. It uses only information published before 2026-01-28T23:59:59, mainly SK hynix's FY2025 results press release dated 2026-01-28. It was not actually written before the target-quarter earnings release.

Base quarter: In Q4 2025, SK hynix reported revenue of KRW 32.8267 trillion, operating profit of KRW 19.1696 trillion, operating margin of 58%, and net income of KRW 15.2460 trillion. FY2025 revenue was KRW 97.1467 trillion, operating profit KRW 47.2063 trillion, net income KRW 42.9479 trillion. HBM revenue more than doubled for the full year. HBM4 mass-production preparation was completed in September 2025, and large-scale production is underway.

Core questions for 2026Q1:
1. HBM4 ramp pace and DRAM mix.
2. Sustainability of conventional server DRAM and NAND/eSSD demand.
3. Operating margin capacity near 58% under seasonal weakness and new product costs.

Upside and downside factors (inference, not company guidance):
- Upside: better HBM4 ramp, tight server DRAM, strong QLC eSSD.
- Downside: seasonal decline, NAND softness, DRAM price pressure, HBM4 ramp costs.

Verification points for the 2026Q1 report (expected 2026-04-23): revenue QoQ change, operating margin, HBM/HBM4 share, conventional DRAM and NAND trends, capex and capacity execution, full-year guidance, dividend/share cancellation updates.

Source: https://news.skhynix.com/en/sk-hynix-announces-fy25-financial-results/

HBM 收入同比翻倍以上是 2025 全年口径，还是 2025Q4 单季口径？若不明确，会高估 2025Q4 的 HBM 贡献。
